credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Red lacquered leather box with hand-painted floral and bird motifs in blues, greens, and browns. Box opens and has a brass diamond-shape clasp on a square brass foundation. Interior is a rust-color brown. There is a lot of keys inside - some tagged with G. O'Keeffe's handwriting: "Padlock on lower closet door," RASA Bag", and  "Don't know." Two tags are red, the rest are white. Not all keys are labelled. One red tag is not attached to anything and reads, "O'Keeffe Abiquiu, N.M." One key has a circular charm attached with prayer hands on one side and the serenity prayer on the other.
dimensions: 4 1/8 in H x 7 1/4 W x 4 1/2 in L
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Addison Doty
title: Jewelry Box with keys
